test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Based on the above, how is T related to P if ‘P @ Q # R & S @ T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

Given: P @ Q # R & S @ T

P @ Q → P is the husband of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95538c21d90ca846cfd9c62b9279352f2c1918da621aa52d1c46d8e026e0c37f.png] 

Q # R → Q is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50399416c83a79ca3b4b11d9fccc47011930aa30d93c3b62d918aead9ad93461.png] 

R & S → R is the sister of S.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec1518e37aa367cd5e642b49e31b7f38abdd2fa98e226d4632ad19737e2232cd.png] 

S @ T → S is the husband of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eacfe6774fa88c3c507dfdb946bb3e2a3c67b54bb6e8742a111b5c2b33c707ae.png] ​

So, T is the son's wife or daughter-in-law of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".
